classification.difficultyReason: Use the square grid to test line relationships and add the corresponding geometry symbols.

inlines.text: A diagram is drawn on a square grid.
Decide whether these statements are true or false.

spec.description: A 16-column by 7-row dotted blue square grid. Four equally spaced vertical segments AQ, BR, CS and DT share upper and lower levels. EG is horizontal through F and ends at G. NP is horizontal through O. Diagonal HM crosses the verticals at I, J, K and L. Upright labels A–T occur once each.
spec.mathematics: AQ, BR, CS and DT are parallel. EG and NP are parallel and perpendicular to the vertical segments where they meet. HM is oblique. The original embedded image208.png resolves the upper horizontal endpoint as G, not K. Grid coordinates encode visual placement only and are not numerical student givens.
spec.answerVisibility: No parallel arrows or right-angle squares appear in the question. These are added only by the solution overlay.

answer.worked: True. $AQ$ and $BR$ follow separate vertical grid lines, so they run in the same direction and never meet.
True. Horizontal $NP$ and vertical $CS$ meet at $O$ at a right angle.
False. A line perpendicular to vertical $BR$ would be horizontal. $HM$ is oblique, so the angle at $J$ is not a right angle.
True. $BR$ and $DT$ follow separate vertical grid lines.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Add arrows and right-angle symbols to show parallel and perpendicular lines.

answer.short: Matching single arrows on $AQ$, $BR$, $CS$ and $DT$; matching double arrows on $EG$ and $NP$; right-angle squares at $F$, $G$, $N$, $O$ and $P$.
answer.worked: $AQ\parallel BR\parallel CS\parallel DT$ and $EG\parallel NP$. Use a different arrow pattern for each parallel family. Mark right angles at $F$, $G$, $N$, $O$ and $P$, where horizontal and vertical geometry segments meet. Leave $HM$ unmarked.

spec.description: Complete editable square-grid solution, with all twenty original point labels, distinct parallel families and right-angle marks. Natural bounds include every label after final-size calibration.
spec.mathematics: Right-angle squares are at F, G, N, O and P. EG ends at G, so no right-angle marker is placed at K. Equivalent positions of parallel marks and right-angle sectors are acceptable.
